recommendation: Keep the commit. The formal base and specific-profile differentials already reflect the applied Must Support decisions, so this targeted narrative correction completes the remaining current-build mismatch for FHIR-48427.
issue_request: FHIR-48427 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO R6 issue reporting inconsistent Must Support use in the Vital Signs Base Profile: component Must Support had been removed by FHIR-47136, but value[x] Must Support and text implying a valueQuantity result still remained. The request was to keep Must Support expectations in specific vital signs profiles rather than the base profile and not make the base narrative require valueQuantity as the only result shape.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly named FHIR-48427. The March 2025 FHIR-47136 vital signs commits, especially 983b8c8cd0 and follow-ups, removed Must Support from base Observation.value[x], Observation.dataAbsentReason, Observation.component, and component sub-elements while leaving Must Support on common base metadata. FHIR-30934 added the Vital Signs Must Support expectations section, and the already-published FHIR-49736 reconciliation removed stale component-specific summary text from the base StructureDefinition.
additional_context: The 2025-03-21 OO minutes list FHIR-48427 under the base-profile Must Support Jira discussion and record it as Persuasive with Modification because the concern should have been covered by other vital signs tickets, then marked Applied. The current Vital Signs IG includes observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml, and StructureDefinition/vitalsigns has vsp-2 allowing value[x], component, hasMember, or dataAbsentReason rather than always requiring a numeric value. Zulip searches found no directly relevant or conflicting FHIR-48427 discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml so the mandatory-data bullet describes the current base choices: Observation.value[x], populated Observation.component elements, Observation.hasMember, or Observation.dataAbsentReason when none are present. The revised text preserves UCUM-unit guidance for numeric vital sign profiles without implying every base-profile Observation must carry valueQuantity.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml: updated the mandatory-data bullet for the Vital Signs Base profile to match vsp-2 and remove the overbroad numeric-result requirement.
